videos.title: Lula and Bolsonaro Face Off in Brazil Vote
videos.description: Bloomberg Brazil Country Chief Filipe Pacheco is on Bloomberg This Weekend as voters cast ballots in a closely contested presidential election between incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, with smaller-party candidates also competing in the first round. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Pacheco explains the importance of turnout, the potential for an Oct. 25 runoff and concerns about possible foreign interference as Brazil conducts its election. Bloomberg’s latest coverage confirms the race is tight and that a runoff will be held if no candidate wins a majority Sunday. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Supreme Court Opens Term With Climate Case
videos.description: Bloomberg Supreme Court Reporter Greg Stohr is on Bloomberg This Weekend previewing a new term shaped by the court’s growing emergency docket and a major climate case over whether Boulder, Colorado, can pursue state-law claims against oil companies. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Stohr says Justice Samuel Alito’s recusal creates the possibility of a 4-4 split and discusses renewed questions about Supreme Court ethics, potential changes to the court and Alito’s eventual retirement. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
